summary: For the target-valid exact-rank-three family A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m), any finite Brascamp--Lieb datum that interpolates each original coordinate between its unnormalized ambiguity L2 factor and its difference-section mass q_j forces theta_0=0 and total ambiguity weights at most 2 on each rank-one bank, hence total Theta<=4. The resulting bound on |phi| is at best the nonintegrable |t|^-1 threshold. This does not refute QFORM: grouping a whole source bank first and applying the source-valid Ball--Rogozin projection theorem gives ||p_Q||_infinity<=pi sqrt(2) for the same family. Latest partner account03/B16's physical-triple theorem gives only <105 m^(2/3) on this family, confirming aggregate-before-inversion is necessary.
